question:
Complete the following sentence using the correct word.
The lecturer explained the complicated theory so __________ that even the least experienced students could understand it.

options.text: supervenes
perspicuously
concatenated
No loaf is so hard but it may be softened in water.

question: What is the meaning of the word “supervenes”?

options.text: To explain something in a clear and understandable manner.
To connect several things in a continuous sequence.
To occur or arise as a subsequent development, often unexpectedly.
To overcome a difficulty through patience and gradual effort.

question:

The editor __________ the separate eyewitness accounts into a single, continuous narrative that revealed the sequence of events.

options.text: perspicuously
supervenes
No loaf is so hard but it may be softened in water.
concatenated

question: What does the proverb “You never miss a slice from a cut loaf” mean?

options.text: People often fail to appreciate something until it is no longer available.
Small amounts taken from an existing supply may go unnoticed, especially when the supply is already divided or abundant.
Difficult situations can always be resolved through patience and repeated effort.
Information becomes easier to understand when it is explained clearly.

question: What is the meaning of the proverb “No loaf is so hard but it may be softened in water”?

options.text: A problem becomes impossible to solve once it has resisted the first attempt.
People should avoid difficult tasks because their efforts may be wasted.
Even a difficult or stubborn situation may be improved through patience, persistence, and suitable methods.
Small losses are insignificant when resources are plentiful.
